::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 16th 1896  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS Cheltenham Ladies College 0941
:::

Dear Madam
I am sorry to say [‘The Mice at Play’](cmy_books/cmybook_35.qmd) is gone out of print and I do not know how to recover it.

There are some nice plays for children by [Miss Jenner](people/person_762.qmd) called Terra Cotta plays published by Innes, and another set by [Mr A Heathcote](people/person_653.qmd) called Ragged Robin published by Allen.  The second among the latter is good for little children[^1]

yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: CMY was evidently consfusing Amabel Jenner,  *Half-hour Plays: Rumpelstilskin and Other Plays from Old Fairy Tales. Adapted either for the village school or the drawing-room* (London: Smith 1889) and Constance  M. Prevost, *Terra Cotta Plays* (London,  Smith 1888).  The other work mentioned is Arthur Malcolm Heathcote, *Ragged Robin and Other Plays for Children* (London: Allen 1890).
